newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo ends steady vs mark, seen rising.
newsitem.headline: Escudo ends steady vs mark, seen rising.

text.p: 1645 GMT - The escudo ended steady against the mark, but dealers said it could rise in coming days as institutional investors buy the Portuguese currency to finance the purchase of EDP shares after its partial privatisation on June 16. Concerns over the timing of the launch of the euro at the forthcoming June 16-17 EU leaders' summit at Amsterdam could also have an impact on the escudo, dealers said. The escudo closed at 101.20/23 per mark, compared with 101.21/25 at the opening.
